title: Fix cloud providers to respect LlmMaxResponseTokens config
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — MSA-LLM-003

`AnthropicProvider.cs` (line ~47) and `OpenAICompatibleProvider.cs` (line ~65) hardcode `MaxTokens = 512`, ignoring `options.LlmMaxResponseTokens` (default 300). `GeminiProvider.cs` has no max-token parameter at all — responses are unbounded.

**Recommendation:** Apply the `OllamaProvider` pattern to all providers: use `options.LlmMaxResponseTokens > 0 ? options.LlmMaxResponseTokens : 512` for Anthropic and OpenAI, and add `generationConfig` with `maxOutputTokens` to Gemini.
